title: uncertainty
content_html:
uncertainty

In 10,000, an imperfect lens raises the question of how we could measure the limitations of the instrument we are looking through. Some uncertainty can be expressed as a range or probability. We can also be uncertain about which description, model or recollection to trust. The series certainty gives that question another setting. What would give us more confidence in a reading, and what can a work gain by leaving the question open? 10,000 · Memory, Verification, and the Limits of Knowing

Reading note. Existentialism. In Sartre’s lecture, a student must decide between two obligations with no rule that settles the choice for him. The imperfect lens in 10,000 raises uncertainty about what can be known. Sartre’s example raises uncertainty about how to act with what is known. What would count as enough to go on in each case? Existentialism Is a Humanism
